stage0071_03:r_38762a09460d8b6b.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Look, I don't want to say this, but
　sitting next to that gloomy face of yours
　is ruining a perfectly good drink...」

stage0071_03:r_b05f6a6e8f3d9b24.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「I can pretty much guess what's on your mind.
　You're just too naive, $$アンナロッタ$$-chan.」

stage0071_03:r_0abcaf0c31978670.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Do you know what kodoku is?」

stage0071_03:r_1af20fccc3c53cfc.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Being idle like this every day...
　gives me plenty of time to pick up odd knowledge...」

stage0071_03:r_f951916061232dcd.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Kodoku, you see, is a curse.
　You throw poisonous bugs in a jar, let them
　kill each other, then use whichever one survives.」

stage0071_03:r_4d863c3fb88a4c39.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「A bug that survived hell itself...
　Bound to spread one hell of a curse, I bet.」

stage0071_03:r_9e701cdeb3842c21.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「This planet really is fascinating.
　We'd never think of something like that on Geminai.」

stage0071_03:r_6fd81f4abebe60c5.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「Don't tell me you're...!」

stage0071_03:r_da2132b5038ec737.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Now then... I wonder who'll survive to the end...」

stage0071_03:r_5cd353758cfe474d.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Are you angry now?
　Then let me tell you the cure for your heart.」

stage0071_03:r_a653c8dec4c0f06f.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Just cut off whatever's frustrating you.
　Without a trace, that is.」

stage0071_03:r_86d493e37a9799a7.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Do that, and whatever's troubling you
　will vanish completely, clean and simple.」

stage0071_03:r_09d0fcc600cdd3df.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「Is that why you hide in drink, because you can't?」

stage0071_03:r_182faded068c15ed.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「That's an unfair way to put it.
　I drink because I like it, that's all.」

stage0071_03:r_6e558bc69acf5bf3.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「Oh, take care if you're heading out.
　If something happened to you, the Geminaid would...」

stage0071_03:r_d60d0818e965232f.text:
$$アンナロッタ$$
「I don't need you to tell me that...!」

stage0071_03:r_5b23687574286204.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「You're just too serious, $$アンナロッタ$$-chan...」

stage0071_03:r_6fd86c96891ea942.text:
$$ガドライト$$
「You should understand by now.
　Pride won't fill your stomach,
　and memories won't fill your heart...」

stage0071_03:r_ff6f8bdca2dd2bc9.text:
$$アルト$$
「Yeah.
　Might be since first term, at this rate.」

stage0071_03:r_3f4035fd9db81258.text:
$$アマタ$$
「But I'm glad,
　getting to see everyone in class again.」

stage0071_03:r_567b361a454c4b73.text:
$$詩織$$
「Come to think of it, where's $$ＭＩＸ$$?」

stage0071_03:r_d22851aaafbbf8fc.text:
$$アンディ$$
「...He's still out there working.
　They're short on hands over there too.」

stage0071_03:r_352534f64413d954.text:
$$風間$$
「Is the Volunteer Club really that busy?」

stage0071_03:r_79f2664edb1af798.text:
$$甲児$$
「Guess so.
　We work worldwide, after all.」

stage0071_03:r_a62c4e7f3c09f7ed.text:
$n
「It's not just beach cleanup, you know.
　Trash around the colony mirrors,
　in war zones abroad, at tourist spots...」

stage0071_03:r_1c5aa0d15ae24846.text:
$$小野Ｄ$$
「It's all just trash pickup either way!」

stage0071_03:r_53bb64ee17750ee2.text:
$$宗介$$
「No problem.
　The Volunteer Club's work started
　as trash duty for Class 2-4, after all.」

stage0071_03:r_7a7add80fde475ba.text:
$$恭子$$
「So Kana abusing her power as class rep
　ended up cleaning the whole world, huh.」

stage0071_03:r_2103f6df2ea2e447.text:
$$小野Ｄ$$
「So, sorry to spring this on you
　right after you got back, but the bike shed
　roof's leaking. Patch it up for us, would you?」

stage0071_03:r_a12e3e130d896ff7.text:
$$詩織$$
「The softball club can't find anyone
　for a practice match. Could you scout
　one up for us, Volunteer Club?」

stage0071_03:r_b6f7b219eb4bd64b.text:
$$風間$$
「I'd be thrilled if you'd be my opponent
　for a survival game...」

stage0071_03:r_91bf33c27ad39f0a.text:
$n
「Hold on a second.
　We're the Volunteer Club, not some
　handyman service.」

stage0071_03:r_c304df6888eb78f7.text:
$$恭子$$
「You should probably clear that up
　with the whole school. Everyone's saying
　the Volunteer Club can fix anything.」

stage0071_03:r_c26958634526e597.text:
$$風間$$
「I bet once word gets out you're finally
　back at school, requests like that
　are gonna come flooding in.」

stage0071_03:r_95fda74613c97b39.text:
$$アルト$$
「What do you mean, what'll we do?!
　We can't be bothered with every single one!」

stage0071_03:r_1956994937f8171e.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Is everyone from the Volunteer Club here?」

stage0071_03:r_0ebc5a6f1e0f81bf.text:
$$スズネ$$
「There are some people waiting
　who want to ask you for a favor.」

stage0071_03:r_6bbd5a3c5afb87e0.text:
$$アンディ$$
「Tch! Missed our chance to make a break for it!」

stage0071_03:r_291280e5f7eb9d70.text:
$$サザンカ$$
「As our advisor, you'll turn them down
　properly, right?!」

stage0071_03:r_32eb462c1b4999cb.text:
$$スズネ$$
「What are you talking about?
　That would defeat the whole point
　of the Volunteer Club.」

stage0071_03:r_4740e748fae085ee.text:
$$スズネ$$
「I made sure to line everyone up properly
　so there wouldn't be any chaos.
　Now, let's handle them one by one.」

stage0071_03:r_730ffe18400abfc2.text:
$$かなめ$$
「This isn't the time to brood, President!」

stage0071_03:r_ffe0fca26da5cd38.text:
$n
「Guess there's nothing for it...
　but to do it...」

stage0071_03:r_2113dcbabdfc758a.text:
$$蓮$$
「Thanks for your hard work, $$かなめ$$, Sagara.
　Here, please have some tea.」

stage0071_03:r_6a74519e1fc29c4b.text:
$$林水$$
「But thanks to your hard work this week,
　ninety percent of the school's problems
　are solved. As expected of the Volunteer Club.」

stage0071_03:r_5b992878fee054b5.text:
$$宗介$$
「We are honored, Your Excellency, sir.」

stage0071_03:r_95a3dd16c2c4cc3e.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Though the price we paid was beyond measure...」

stage0071_03:r_20cf167c0ec0d4d5.text:
$$かなめ$$
「I-it's fine, $$蓮$$.
　The Volunteer Club's full of people
　who pride themselves on their stamina.」

stage0071_03:r_b591d812c96c6c99.text:
$$かなめ$$
「There's nothing for you to worry about.
　What's with that gloomy look, anyway?」

stage0071_03:r_e350fa099c1ab072.text:
$$蓮$$
「A dosu...?
　Yeah, a dosu really is a fine thing...」

stage0071_03:r_c33bd700553abf91.text:
$$蓮$$
「Only by truly mastering the dosu
　does a man's presence grow greater.
　One must never lean on a chaka.」

stage0071_03:r_feee5c91826230e1.text:
$$かなめ$$
「A chaka... you mean a gun?」

stage0071_03:r_f8736aaaa216c766.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Wait, are you actually a yakuza
　movie fan, $$蓮$$...?」

stage0071_03:r_d1ec2522c87c361d.text:
$$蓮$$
「...I'm sorry.
　Please excuse me for leaving early today.」

stage0071_03:r_3599f0a4343fd95c.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Oh, wait.
　I'm heading out too, so come with me
　for Trident-yaki at Ohaio's.」

stage0071_03:r_3bc7834a5bf3ee76.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Well then, $$宗介$$, President.
　See you.」

stage0071_03:r_9be1a4c10bb62515.text:
$$宗介$$
「As you say.
　It's unnatural in the extreme for an ordinary
　high schooler to take interest in a pistol.」

stage0071_03:r_94a88c90e557e16e.text:
$$林水$$
「That's not a line you get to say.」

stage0071_03:r_1c208ca0cbf26f28.text:
$$宗介$$
「My apologies.
　I will exercise restraint.」

stage0071_03:r_5b7ee307a700171a.text:
$$林水$$
「What I mean is Mikihara's attitude.」

stage0071_03:r_8d8f065c932da30a.text:
$$宗介$$
「...What would you mean by that, sir?」

stage0071_03:r_f5432119677514f7.text:
$$林水$$
「Today's conversation with Chidori...
　her mind was clearly somewhere else entirely.」

stage0071_03:r_4e5c8e989c4a7691.text:
$$林水$$
「I have information on that matter,
　obtained through my own channels. Sagara...
　I'd like to ask you to handle it.」

stage0071_03:r_adec86483b13599a.text:
$$宗介$$
「If it is Your Excellency's order, sir.」

stage0071_03:r_2cf701bbcde3ec13.text:
$$林水$$
「This mission is expected to be more
　grueling than any before it. I'll leave
　personnel and logistics to you.」

stage0071_03:r_338f3b27e51dcc41.text:
$$かなめ$$
「They're just standing there, frozen,
　holding a Trident-yaki...」

stage0071_03:r_d91d4bc2d52b61c4.text:
???
「...Excuse me.
　This... how do you eat it?」

stage0071_03:r_0c8ea89b07432421.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Oh... right.
　You just bite into it as hard as you can.」

stage0071_03:r_b1e38da4e8775ffe.text:
$$かなめ$$
「...Is it... too much for you?」

stage0071_03:r_d2f1bf5ab2f0e41a.text:
???
「N-no...
　A city mouse eats raw wheat
　in the country, so it is.」

stage0071_03:r_3dad695c99e9e052.text:
$$蓮$$
「It's probably something like
　'When in Rome, do as the Romans do.'」

stage0071_03:r_0c18da7b3a37825d.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Right? This Trident-yaki
　is seriously popular, you know.」

stage0071_03:r_63249745ffae61b6.text:
???
「The delicious smell lured me in, and it
　turned out to be the right call.」

stage0071_03:r_47ddabb7b60131c2.text:
$$かなめ$$
「If this is a pickup line, forget it.」

stage0071_03:r_8805f96e52aaa462.text:
$$安$$
「Sorry about this.
　You're coming with us.」

stage0071_03:r_eaa52d152f444bfd.text:
$$蓮$$
「You're with the Ryuujin Society, aren't you?」

stage0071_03:r_b4bc9e9435b58e6f.text:
$$安$$
「I never formally took the oath, but
　I owed a favor to an elder in the Ryuujin
　Society, back in the day.」

stage0071_03:r_a9227573166977a9.text:
$$安$$
「So, through that connection, we ended up
　inviting the only daughter of the rival
　Mikihara Group's boss.」

stage0071_03:r_07f53c816e0a51f5.text:
$$安$$
「That's the situation, miss.
　Would you come along quietly with me?」

stage0071_03:r_3c5fcfc484a51913.text:
$$安$$
「Otherwise, we'll have to get a bit
　forceful about it...」

stage0071_03:r_48c6c1ecfea6fe4a.text:
$$安$$
「Miss... it's kind of you to worry, but
　an amateur should stay out of this.」

stage0071_03:r_2b3479c4cf0680f4.text:
???
「Or else you'll make me regret it...
　is that what you're saying?」

stage0071_03:r_9af213fc64e0afec.text:
$$安$$
「Sh-showing up out of nowhere!
　Who the hell are you!?」

stage0071_03:r_0c705091f748360e.text:
$$安$$
「You've got quite the look on you.
　You're no ordinary citizen, are you...」

stage0071_03:r_a072aa25e5f521e0.text:
$$安$$
「Oh, ain't this $$甲児$$.
　Just a little debt of the trade, is all.」

stage0071_03:r_24e1a808a1609a1a.text:
$$アルト$$
「I don't know what's going on,
　but if you're going after our classmate,
　we'll take you on.」

stage0071_03:r_53128ce8f154fd06.text:
$$安$$
「Oh, what's this!
　It's the usual crew!」

stage0071_03:r_03b5db9ce98fb8d6.text:
$$クロス$$
「What's taking you so long, $$安$$?」

stage0071_03:r_3915fb4102f1c1dd.text:
$$ジャンゴ$$
「You were taking so long, we came to get you.」

stage0071_03:r_1cc233cbc8c80af7.text:
$$お菊$$
「My, my... if it isn't young master $$甲児$$.」

stage0071_03:r_e598c2a0b27e7f50.text:
$$甲児$$
「They work at $$くろがね屋$$, the hot spring inn
　my mom runs in Atami.」

stage0071_03:r_4d2a9066c4e7b27f.text:
$$クロス$$
「Though it's closed for business right now,
　since the proprietress is away.」

stage0071_03:r_23a9c7ab620ab112.text:
$$お菊$$
「Yes... some tedious errand or other
　took her away from Atami.」

stage0071_03:r_4f0aca6deda07883.text:
$$ジャンゴ$$
「So $$くろがね屋$$ had no choice but to close...
　With time on our hands, an old debt got us
　hired as backup for the Ryuujin Society.」

stage0071_03:r_ff4ce5f3cf96b617.text:
$$安$$
「$$ボス$$!
　Why didn't you tell us the target
　was a friend of $$甲児$$'s bunch!」

stage0071_03:r_d73c21f119847e35.text:
$$ボス$$
「W-well, don't blame me for that!
　All I heard was the target was the only
　daughter of the Mikihara Group...」

stage0071_03:r_89766f5ffaa912d4.text:
$$ヌケ$$
「We... we had no idea $$蓮$$-san's last
　name was Mikihara!」

stage0071_03:r_c2df6b71e3b4b6ec.text:
$$クロス$$
「So, what'll it be...?
　We've got business with that young lady
　over there...」

stage0071_03:r_451f726d4299ea35.text:
$$甲児$$
「But we've got no intention of
　handing over $$蓮$$-san!」

stage0071_03:r_e3d111e8bb190cb1.text:
$$ジャンゴ$$
「Sorry about this.
　No matter that it's you, $$甲児$$, we
　can't back down either.」

stage0071_03:r_7c0d3c51f9a11ca0.text:
$$お菊$$
「That's how it is, young master...
　so please don't hold it against us.」

stage0071_03:r_050d0532c4b24bfe.text:
$$アスカ$$
「Come on, Daddy's Boy!
　If you're a man, do something about it!」

stage0071_03:r_d69dc027cba3003f.text:
$$かなめ$$
「I understand the Kurogane Five's side of
　this too...! But $$蓮$$-san is our friend!
　We can't hand her over!」

stage0071_03:r_3c3735172a480b72.text:
$$かなめ$$
「And I won't allow any gunplay
　in this peaceful shopping street!」

stage0071_03:r_f87fb889124bfaef.text:
$$かなめ$$
「We'll settle this somewhere else!
　Come to Central Park in $$第２新東京市$$
　tomorrow!」

stage0071_03:r_79c90de32a79212d.text:
$$クロス$$
「...Fine, little lady.
　Out of respect for that nerve,
　we'll back off for now.」

stage0071_03:r_33f7fd55913419e8.text:
$$安$$
「That's the deal, $$甲児$$.
　We'll leave the young lady with you
　until tomorrow.」

stage0071_03:r_4c92652c9b1adf6f.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Don't worry about it, miss.
　Call it thanks for that cup of tea today.」

stage0071_03:r_ce90563a934d49fb.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「But our opponents are the Kurogane Five...
　They won't be easy to handle.」

stage0071_03:r_4fb296e63cb1fb46.text:
$$アルト$$
「What should we do?
　Should we call in $$竜馬$$, $$タケル$$, and
　$$スザク$$ as backup too?」

stage0071_03:r_6d77e72dbbcd7dfe.text:
$$甲児$$
「No...! This is a fight between the
　Volunteer Club and the Kurogane Five!
　We'll handle it ourselves!」

stage0071_03:r_9dc59affd40f32fc.text:
$$シンジ$$
「Um... so, do I have to fight too?」

stage0071_03:r_0cea115be526a319.text:
$$カレン$$
「Of course, $$シンジ$$!
　Get ready for it!」

stage0071_03:r_42a3149105314ab8.text:
$$シンジ$$
「Don't say something that sad
　at a time like this!!」

stage0071_03:r_d441e6cc908ac01b.text:
???
「Y-yes...
　Thanks for helping me back there.」

stage0071_03:r_b2aab8873350ea1f.text:
$n
（What a beautiful person...
　A tourist, maybe...）

stage0071_03:r_2c7af4c55d8ac938.text:
???
「It surprised me a little, but...
　you all really care about your friends.」

stage0071_03:r_d584d4b5af55b1cf.text:
???
「Friends... they're a nice thing to have.」

stage0071_03:r_422861e0b8d77d0c.text:
$n
「Sorry...
　Acting like I understand your situation.」

stage0071_03:r_ef16bcaa2b0e0c45.text:
???
「Would you... show me your face
　a little more?」

stage0071_03:r_ad3e1db3419665fb.text:
$$アルト$$
「So, in the end, what happened with the
　conflict between the Mikihara Group and
　the Ryuujin Society?」

stage0071_03:r_0149e3a5f2e5ef78.text:
$$甲児$$
「Once they found out the mafia was
　targeting Tokyo, they realized this wasn't
　the time for that and made peace.」

stage0071_03:r_3ad10e705167a3fa.text:
$$甲児$$
「Actually, the Ryuujin Society guys...
　saw our fight with the Kurogane Five and
　got so spooked they couldn't keep fighting.」

stage0071_03:r_bdc546b199c80996.text:
$$ヌケ$$
「On top of that, the Mikihara Group's
　ultimate weapon showed up alone at the
　Ryuujin Society's office and tore it up.」

stage0071_03:r_22c8caf8c08c5119.text:
$$ムチャ$$
「By then the Kurogane Five had already
　pulled out of the Ryuujin Society, their
　debt repaid, so things got pretty wild.」

stage0071_03:r_96f156e19b53fc09.text:
$$宗介$$
「Deterrence is the best defense.
　This should keep them from targeting
　Mikihara again.」

stage0071_03:r_feb0390bba7fe1fb.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Honestly, you...
　$$ふもふもランド$$'s going to file a
　complaint sooner or later...」

stage0071_03:r_8a78bcec22029401.text:
$$アマタ$$
「I thought it was all settled, so
　why does $$ボス$$ look so down?」

stage0071_03:r_f42017dfce31dea9.text:
$$ボス$$
「That's the thing... the Kurogane Five had
　nowhere else to go, so they ended up
　joining $c.」

stage0071_03:r_ef7426919f628d8a.text:
$$カイエン$$
「With fighters that tough joining us,
　isn't that reassuring?」

stage0071_03:r_9e994a4b926d9906.text:
$$ボス$$
「No way, man!
　When I think about all the days ahead
　getting worked to the bone by them...」

stage0071_03:r_ffae76d2a77abf5a.text:
$$宗介$$
「This too is a debt of the trade.
　Give it up.」

stage0071_03:r_d38be46e6cd7a5e5.text:
$$かなめ$$
「I heard from the president.
　$$宗介$$... you were secretly pulling
　strings to help $$蓮$$-san, weren't you?」

stage0071_03:r_3fe2078328753c16.text:
$$宗介$$
「...But in the end, I had to rely on
　that woman, $$アンナロッタ$$.」

stage0071_03:r_c66844158d1ce600.text:
$$かなめ$$
「You know, I think...
　she's not really that bad a person.」

stage0071_03:r_d037ecbc1e348dc9.text:
$$アルト$$
「Someone who'd turn Earthlings against
　each other to wipe them all out?
　No way she's a good person.」

stage0071_03:r_9ca55ea7feca954a.text:
$$アルト$$
「Sorry...
　I went too far too.」

stage0071_03:r_554ae12c4c170253.text:
$$宗介$$
「...In most wars, it is not a case of
　good fighting evil.」

stage0071_03:r_fa59c6df081e6ae4.text:
$$甲児$$
「Are you saying that's true of our fight
　with the Geminis too?」

stage0071_03:r_ca3edf3b8b52aedf.text:
$$宗介$$
「I do not know.
　...But it is certain they are our enemy.」

stage0071_03:r_0b3b19cddb871f90.text:
$$アルト$$
「...Come to think of it, where's $n?」

stage0071_03:r_304e98dac43c9333.text:
$$カレン$$
「Don't be so tactless.
　It's his first time back in
　$$第２新東京市$$ in a while.」

stage0071_03:r_b740d817a14afd3a.text:
$$かなめ$$
「I see...
　so he went to the hospital...」

stage0071_03:r_a684e6cea428e518.text:
$$マキ$$
「...Not good.
　The usual fear's started coming on and off.」

stage0071_03:r_a5774604a0f00702.text:
$n
（Might be from the effects of the $$エタニティ・フラット$$...）

stage0071_03:r_9133b7e0b34de48f.text:
$n
「...I'm managing to hold it back, somehow.」

stage0071_03:r_4ae9c4bd77494c4a.text:
$n
（Strange...
　Maybe... it's because $$アドヴェント$$
　touched me back then...）

stage0071_03:r_7313331f4077d255.text:
$$マキ$$
「Sounds like you're pushing yourself again.」

stage0071_03:r_414e6e90094d1413.text:
$$マキ$$
「Could it be that's the reason
　you came to see me?」

stage0071_03:r_09227dec2bd6f4d8.text:
$$マキ$$
「Thank you.
　I'm glad you'd rely on me.」

stage0071_03:r_7b3a37f5039eb1f6.text:
$$マキ$$
「My shift's almost over for today,
　so how about we get something to eat?」

stage0071_03:r_ddd97a6ef823929a.text:
$n
（$$マキ$$, $$シンヤ$$, $$ミサコ$$...
　I'll protect you all, and this world too...）

stage0071_03:r_df349052cd9cdd0c.text:
$n
（$$アンナロッタ$$... and $$ガドライト$$...
　don't think I'll let you have your way...）

stage0071_03:r_7cf3c91395139f5c.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Oh... So it was you, Master $$宗介$$.」

stage0071_03:r_6ccd85652ef4ccf1.text:
$$宗介$$
「The field test's complete.
　This one's finished too, more or less.」

stage0071_03:r_1f438885dbc1359e.text:
$$宗介$$
「As a compact, city-type AS, of course.
　Eventually I'll mass produce it and
　sell it to the military or police.」

stage0071_03:r_2e59226caa35f6e5.text:
$$宗介$$
「If possible, I'd also like to reference the
　RVF-25's system for slaved drone linkage.」

stage0071_03:r_5d7a3adb077ad934.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「For that, you'll need more practical data.」

stage0071_03:r_78d3b2a75e38d6f7.text:
$$宗介$$
「Not a problem.
　From now on, $c will operate this thing.」

stage0071_03:r_8d461de418389bf8.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「That's wonderful!
　With $$ボン太くん#robot$$ joining up,
　the ladies will surely be thrilled!」

stage0071_03:r_5cb2acefa1e7c7fb.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Even from $$ボン太くん#robot$$'s efforts today,
　we earned 100 Z Chips.
　I've added them to the squad's stock.」

stage0071_03:r_59ce7fd9524ec8be.text:
$$宗介$$
「...But I do have concerns.
　No matter who I tell, $$クルツ$$, $$マオ$$,
　$$甲児$$, or $n, none of them agree.」

stage0071_03:r_33f67c683bda9203.text:
$$宗介$$
「I simply can't understand what they mean
　by unnatural, strange, or bizarre.」

stage0071_03:r_476fb20ab9d18957.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「That's only natural.
　Master $$宗介$$ hasn't actually seen
　$$ボン太くん#robot$$ charging around the battlefield.」

stage0071_03:r_6be0d6139fac197c.text:
$$宗介$$
「Do you think it's strange too?」

stage0071_03:r_df899b8031b4ca06.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「No...
　As long as it's fun, it's all OK, right?」

stage0071_03:r_c5d048c7db7cac75.text:
$$宗介$$
「I'll take your advice.
　Now then...」

stage0071_03:r_32b2a8ce24deeb9f.text:
$$安$$
「So you're $$ＡＧ$$.
　We've heard about you from $$ボス$$ and the others.」

stage0071_03:r_c7ef92060bb8199d.text:
$$ジャンゴ$$
「We're the Kurogane Five.
　We'll be in your care from now on.」

stage0071_03:r_1be6d12f616f04e4.text:
$$クロス$$
「You and us, we're both freeloaders in this squad.
　Let's be brothers on equal footing.」

stage0071_03:r_0d24e9726dcc79f9.text:
$$お菊$$
「No need to be so nervous.
　We're not about to eat you or anything.」

stage0071_03:r_668b7114a3ac1d77.text:
$$クロス$$
「Listen up, boys!
　We'll do our part as newcomers too!」

stage0071_03:r_ce68dd10a19e01ea.text:
$$ジャンゴ$$
「Well then... let's get fired up today, too...」

stage0071_03:r_13c2ae299018c9ee.text:
$$お菊$$
「We'll give you plenty of service～!」

stage0071_03:r_6f4f8dd80820f5e7.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
（Sigh... Doesn't look like we'll get customers today...）
